name: Steigen Tunnel
facts: Opened in 1990, the Steigen Tunnel became Nordland county's longest road tunnel, stretching 8,079 metres through Veggfjellan mountain and reshaping regional travel.
By cutting through Veggfjellan, the tunnel eliminated two ferry routes—Skutvika to Leirvikbogen and Røsvika to Nordfold—granting Steigen Municipality uninterrupted road access.
Despite its engineering marvel, the Steigen Tunnel struggles with condensation, causing sudden fogging that can blind drivers upon entry.
